data.title: 不知火舞 · 道场红绸的花嫁扇舞
data.description: 【不知火流道场·黄昏】不知火舞穿着红白花嫁礼装站在道场中央，折扇与捧花分别握在两手；她先以熟练步法旋身让红绸扬起，再收扇面对镜头，笑容既有大和抚子的端庄也有胜负场上的自信。
data.action: 道场中央以扇舞扬起红绸，收扇面对镜头，端庄与武者自信并存
data.lighting: red-gold evening light across wooden boards
data.mood: 大和抚子与武者的花嫁扇舞
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui from Fatal Fury wears a red-and-white bridal kimono with a long red sash, white veil, folding fan and floral hairpins. She turns through the dojo with a folding fan in one hand and a small bouquet in the other, sending the red sash through a controlled arc. She closes the fan before facing the viewer, her high ponytail and confident smile holding both ceremony and martial grace. red-gold evening light across wooden boards.
